newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Gorzow to pick muni bond agent early Sept.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Gorzow to pick muni bond agent early Sept.

text.p: Poland's western town of Gorzow Wielkopolski will pick the manager for its planned 20 million zloty municipal bond issue in early September, the Nowa Europa business daily reported on Monday.
It said the issue will be divided into two 10 million zloty tranches, which will have maturities of three and four years respectively.
Gorzow plans to invest the money in modernising its roads, Nowa Europa said.
